R6_bbn_proxy_provenance.status: assumed order-of-magnitude proxies; no BBN reaction network is run
R6_bbn_proxy_provenance.clock_proxy: bare magnitude proxy |delta G/G| ~ 2|phi| (review F01). With g_J = A^2 g_E, A = exp(alpha_Y phi), the Jordan-frame Ricci term carries A^-2/G_* (A^-2 multiplies the Planck mass squared): 1/G_T = A^-2/G_*, i.e. G_T = G_* A^2 = G_* exp(2 alpha_Y phi), so phi < 0 decreases G_T. The tensor coupling G_T, the operationally measured G_lab ~ G_*(1+q) and the bare 2|phi| proxy are different quantities; sign and reference state are not propagated, only |2 phi| is used
R6_bbn_proxy_provenance.sensitivity_reference: Kneller & Steigman 2004 (New J. Phys. 6, 117) fits: dYp ~ 0.16 (S-1), d ln(D/H) ~ 1.6 (S-1), S = H'/H; the code's 1.6 matches, its 0.08 is a factor 2 smaller
